G1722.root: a primary preposition denoting (fixed) position (in place, time or state), and (by implication) instrumentality (medially or constructively), i.e. a relation of rest (intermediate between [[w:G1519]] and [[w:G1537]])
G1722.kjv: about, after, against, + almost, X altogether, among, X as, at, before, between, (here-)by (+ all means), for (… sake of), + give self wholly to, (here-)in(-to, -wardly), X mightily, (because) of, (up-)on, (open-)ly, X outwardly, one, X quickly, X shortly, (speedi-)ly, X that, X there(-in, -on), through(-out), (un-)to(-ward), under, when, where(-with), while, with(-in)
senses: prep, (the most frequently of all in NT), with dative (= Heb. בְּ, Lat. in, with abl.).

Of place, with dative of thing(s), of person(s), in, within, on, at, by, among: ἐν τ. πόλει, [[r:LUK.7.37|Luk 7:37]]; τ. οφθαλμῷ, [[r:MAT.7.3|Mat 7:3]]; τ. κοιλίᾳ, [[r:MAT.12.40|Mat 12:40]]; τ. ὄρει, [[r:2PE.1.18|2Pe 1:18]]; τ. θρόνῳ, [[r:REV.3.21|Rev 3:21]]; τ. δεξιᾷ τ. θεοῦ, [[r:ROM.8.34|Rom 8:34]]; ἐν ἡμῖν Abbott-Smith has ὑμῖν., [[r:LUK.1.1|Luk 1:1]]; of books, ἐν τ. βιβλίῳ, [[r:GAL.3.10|Gal 3:10]]; τ. νόμῳ, [[r:MAT.12.5|Mat 12:5]], al.; ἐν τοῖς τ. Πατρός, in my Father's house (RV; cf. M, Pr., 103), [[r:LUK.2.49|Luk 2:49]]; trop., of the region of thought or feeling, ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ (-αις), [[r:MAT.5.28|Mat 5:28]], [[r:2CO.4.6|2Co 4:6]], al.; τ. συνειδήσεσιν, [[r:2CO.5.11|2Co 5:11]]; after verbs of motion, instead of εἰς (constructio praegnans, a usage extended in late Gk. beyond the limits observed in cl.; cf. Bl., §41, 1; M, Th., 12), ἀποστέλλω... ἐν, [[r:MAT.10.16|Mat 10:16.]] δέδωκεν ἐν τ. χειρί (cf. τιθέναι ἐν χερσί, Hom., Il., i, 441, al.), [[r:JHN.3.35|Jhn 3:35]]; id. after verbs of coming and going (not in cl.), εἰσῆλθε, [[r:LUK.9.46|Luk 9:46]]; ἐξῆλθεν, [[r:LUK.7.17|Luk 7:17.]]

Of state, condition, form, occupation, etc.: ἐν ζωῇ, [[r:ROM.5.10|Rom 5:10]]; ἐν τ. θανάτῳ, [[r:1JN.3.14|1Jn 3:14]]; ἐν πειρασμοῖς, [[r:1PE.1.6|1Pe 1:6]]; ἐν εἰρήνῃ, [[r:MRK.5.25|Mrk 5:25]]; ἐν δόξῃ, [[r:PHP.4.19|Php 4:19]]; ἐν πραΰτητι, [[r:JAS.3.13|Jas 3:13]]; ἐν μυστηρίῳ, [[r:1CO.2.7|1Co 2:7]]; ἐν τ. διδαχῇ, [[r:MRK.4.2|Mrk 4:2]]; of a part as contained in a whole, ἐν τ. ἀμπέλῳ, [[r:JHN.15.4|Jhn 15:4]]; ἐν ἑνὶ σώματι, [[r:ROM.12.4|Rom 12:4]]; of accompanying objects or persons (simple dative in cl.), with, ἐν αἵματι, [[r:HEB.9.25|Heb 9:25]]; ἐν δέκα χιλιάσιν, [[r:LUK.14.31|Luk 14:31]] (cf. Ju 14, [[r:ACT.7.14|Act 7:14]]); similarly (cl.), of clothing, armour, arms, ἐν στολαῖς, [[r:MRK.12.38|Mrk 12:38]]; ἐν ἐσθῆτι λαμπρᾷ, [[r:JAS.2.2|Jas 2:2]]; ἐν μαξαίρῃ, [[r:LUK.22.49|Luk 22:49]]; ἐν ῥάβδῳ, [[r:1CO.4.21|1Co 4:21]] (cf. ἐν τόξοις, Xen., Mem., 3, 9, 2); of manner (cl.), ἐν τάχει (= ταχέως), [[r:LUK.18.8|Luk 18:8]] (cf. Bl., §41, 1); of spiritual influence, ἐν πνεύματι, [[r:ROM.8.9|Rom 8:9]]; ἐν π. ἀκαθάρτῳ, [[r:MRK.1.23|Mrk 1:23]]; of the mystical relation of the Christian life and the believer himself, to God and Christ (cf. ICC, Ro., 160f.; Mayor on Ju 1; M, Pr., 103): ἐν Χριστῷ, [[r:ROM.3.24|Rom 3:24, 6:11]], [[r:1CO.3.1|1Co 3:1, 4:10]], [[r:2CO.12.2|2Co 12:2]], [[r:GAL.2.17|Gal 2:17]], [[r:EPH.6.21|Eph 6:21]], [[r:COL.4.7|Col 4:7]], [[r:1TH.4.16|1Th 4:16]], al.

Of the agent, instrument or means (an extension of cl. ἐν of instr.—see LS, see word Ill—corresponding to similar use of Heb. בְּ), by, with: ἐν ὑμῖν κρίνεται ὁ κόσμος (= cl. παρά, C. dative), [[r:1CO.6.2|1Co 6:2]]; ἐν τ. ἄρχοντι τ. δαιμονίων, [[r:MAT.9.34|Mat 9:34]]; ἐν αἵματι, [[r:HEB.9.22|Heb 9:22]]; ἐν ὕδατι, [[r:MAT.3.11|Mat 3:11]], al.; ἐν μαχαίρᾳ ἀποκτενεῖ (cf. the absol. ἐν μ., ἐν ῥάβδῳ, supr., II, which some would classify here), [[r:REV.13.10|Rev 13:10]] ([[r:REV.6.8|cf 6:8]]). Allied to this usage and distinctly Semitic are the following: ἠγόρασας... ἐν τ. αἵματι σου (cf. BDB, see word בְּ, III, 3), [[r:REV.5.9|Rev 5:9]]; ὁμολογεῖν ἐν (= Aram. אודי בּ; cf. McNeile on Mt, I.with; M, Pr., 104), [[r:MAT.10.32|Mat 10:32]], [[r:LUK.12.8|Luk 12:8]]; ὀμνύναι ἐν (= cl. accusative, so [[r:JAS.5.12|Jas 5:12]]), [[r:MAT.5.34|Mat 5:34]], al.; also at the rate of, amounting to, [[r:MRK.4.8|Mrk 4:8]] (WH; vv. ll., εἰς, ἒν), [[r:ACT.7.14|Act 7:14]] (LXX).
in or during a period: ἐν τ. ἡμέρᾳ (νυκτί), [[r:JHN.11.9|Jhn 11:9]], al.; ἐν σαββάτῳ, [[r:MAT.12.2|Mat 12:2]], al.; ἐν τῷ μεταξύ, meanwhile, [[r:JHN.4.31|Jhn 4:31]];

at the time of an event: ἐν τ. παρουσίᾳ, [[r:1CO.15.23|1Co 15:23]]; ἐν τ. ἀναστάσει, [[r:MAT.22.28|Mat 22:28]]; (with) with art. inf., (α) present (so sometimes in cl., but not as in NT = ἕως; V. M, Pr., 215), while: [[r:MAT.13.4|Mat 13:4]], [[r:MRK.6.48|Mrk 6:48]], [[r:GAL.4.18|Gal 4:18]], al.; (β) aor., when, after: [[r:LUK.9.36|Luk 9:36]], al.;

In composition: (1) meaning: (a) with adjectives, it signifies usually the possession of a quality, as ἐνάλιος, ἐν́δοξος; (b) with verbs, continuance in (before ἐν) or motion into (before εἰς), as ἐμμένω, ἐμβαίνω. (ii) Assimilation: ἐν becomes ἐμ- before β, μ, π, φ, ψ; ἐγ- before γ, κ, ξ, χ; ἐλ- before λ. But in the older MSS of NT, followed by modern editions, assimilation is sometimes neglected, as in ἐνγράφω, ἐγκαινίζω, etc. (AS)
(θυμός), to reflect on, ponder: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.1.20|Mat 1:20 9:4]].† (AS)

ἐν-τέλλω -ομαι, to command, enjoin, instruct: before περί [[r:HEB.11.22|Heb 11:22]]; with inf., [[r:MAT.19.7|Mat 19:7]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.1.2|Act 1:2]]; οὕτως, [[r:ACT.13.47|Act 13:47]]; καθώς, [[r:JHN.14.31|Jhn 14:31]] (ἐντολὴν ἔδωκεν, WH); before λέγων, [[r:MAT.17.9|Mat 17:9]]; with inf., [[r:JHN.8.5|Jhn 8:5]]; ἵνα, [[r:MRK.13.34|Mrk 13:34]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.28.20|Mat 28:20]], [[r:MRK.10.3|Mrk 10:3]], [[r:JHN.15.14|Jhn 15:14, 17]]; before περί, with genitive of person(s), [[r:MAT.4.6|Mat 4:6]] and [[r:LUK.4.10|Luk 4:10]] (LXX); διαθήκην ἐ. πρός, with accusative of person(s), [[r:HEB.9.20|Heb 9:20]] (LXX) (cf. [[r:SIR.45.3|Sir 45:3]]).† SYN.: κελεύω, to command, of verbal orders in general; παραγγέλλω, to charge, esp. of the transmitted orders of a military com­mander; ἐντέλλω points rather to the contents of the command (see Thayer, see word κελεύω) (AS)

G1752.forms: ἕνεκα (so [[r:MAT.19.5|Mat 19:5]], [[r:LUK.6.22|Luk 6:22]], [[r:ACT.19.32|Act 19:32 26:21]]; elsewhere, prop, only before a vowel, ἕνεκεν; εἵνεκεν, originally Ionic: [[r:LUK.4.18|Luk 4:18 18:29]], [[r:ACT.28.20|Act 28:20]], [[r:2CO.3.10|2Co 3:10]])
G1752.kjv: because, for (cause, sake), (where-)fore, by reason of, that
senses: prep. with genitive, on account of, because of: [[r:MAT.5.10|Mat 5:10-11 16:25 19:29]], [[r:MRK.8.35|Mrk 8:35]], [[r:LUK.6.22|Luk 6:22]], [[r:ACT.28.20|Act 28:20]], [[r:ROM.8.36|Rom 8:36]], [[r:2CO.3.10|2Co 3:10]]; ἕ. τούτου, [[r:MAT.19.5|Mat 19:5]]; υούτων, [[r:ACT.26.21|Act 26:21]]; τίνος ἕ., [[r:ACT.19.32|Act 19:32]]; before τοῦ, with inf., [[r:2CO.7.12|2Co 7:12]]; οὗ ἕν., [[r:LUK.4.18|Luk 4:18]] (AS)

G1715.strongs: in front of (in place (literally or figuratively) or time)
G1715.kjv: against, at, before, (in presence, sight) of
senses: ἔμ-προσθεν adv. of place (in cl. also of time),
adverbially, before, in front: [[r:LUK.19.28|Luk 19:28]]; εἰς τὸ ἔ., [[r:LUK.19.4|Luk 19:4]]; opposite to ὄπισθεν, [[r:REV.4.6|Rev 4:6]]; opposite to τὰ ὀπίσω, τὰ ἔ., [[r:PHP.3.13|Php 3:13.]]
of rank and dignity (Dem., Plat., al.; LXX, [[r:GEN.48.20|Gen 48:20]]): [[r:JHN.1.15|Jhn 1:15, 30]].† (AS)

generally, a charge, injunction, order, command: [[r:LUK.15.29|Luk 15:29]], [[r:JHN.10.18|Jhn 10:18 11:57 12:49-50 14:31]], [[r:ACT.17.15|Act 17:15]], [[r:COL.4.10|Col 4:10]]; ἐ. σαρκίνη, [[r:HEB.7.16|Heb 7:16, 18]]
Esp. of religious precepts and commandments;
of things commanded Christ by the Father: [[r:JHN.12.49|Jhn 12:49-50 14:31 15:10]]; (with) of the precepts of Christ: [[r:JHN.13.34|Jhn 13:34 14:15, 21 15:10, 12]], [[r:1CO.14.37|1Co 14:37]].

Phrases: before ἵνα, [[r:JHN.13.34|Jhn 13:34 15:12]], [[r:1JN.3.23|1Jn 3:23]] [[r:JHN.4.21|Jn 4:21]], 2Jn 6; ἐντολὴν (ὰς) παραβαίνειν, [[r:MAT.15.3|Mat 15:3]]; ἀκυροῦν, [[r:MAT.15.6|Mat 15:6]] Rec.; τηρεῖν, [[r:MAT.19.17|Mat 19:17]] [[r:JHN.15.10|Jhn 15:10]], al.; ποιεῖν, [[r:1JN.5.2|1Jn 5:2]]; διδόναι, [[r:JHN.11.57|Jhn 11:57]]; λαμβάνειν, [[r:JHN.10.18|Jhn 10:18]], 2Jn 4; ἔχειν, [[r:JHN.14.21|Jhn 14:21]], [[r:HEB.7.5|Heb 7:5]]; ἐ. καὶ δικαιώματα, [[r:LUK.1.6|Luk 1:6]]; ἐντολαὶ ἀνθρώπων (of Jewish tradition), [[r:TIT.1.14|Tit 1:14]]; i. καινή, [[r:JHN.13.34|Jhn 13:34]], [[r:1JN.2.7|1Jn 2:7]], 2Jn 5.† (AS)

G1777.strongs: liable to (a condition, penalty or imputation)
G1777.kjv: in danger of, guilty of, subject to
senses: held in, bound by: with genitive (cl. with dative), δουλείας, [[r:HEB.2.15|Heb 2:15.]]
liable to a charge or action (cl. with dative, of crime): with dative, of the tribunal (MM, Exp., xiii), [[r:MAT.5.21|Mat 5:21-22]]; before εἰς (Field, Notes, 4 f.), [[r:MAT.5.22|Mat 5:22]]

with genitive, of the punishment ([[r:GEN.26.11|Gen 26:11]]): θανάτου, [[r:MAT.26.66|Mat 26:66]], [[r:MRK.14.64|Mrk 14:64]]; (with) with genitive (cl. with dative„ rarely with prep.; MM, Exp., xiii), of the crime ([[r:2MA.13.6|2Ma 13:6]]): [[r:MRK.3.29|Mrk 3:29]];
with genitive, of the thing injured, guilty (absol., in Cl.): [[r:1CO.11.27|1Co 11:27]], [[r:JAS.2.10|Jas 2:10]] (cf. [[r:ISA.54.17|Isa 54:17]]; DB, ii, 268a).† (AS)

G1746.root: from [[w:G1722]] and [[w:G1416]] (in the sense of sinking into a garment)
G1746.strongs: to invest with clothing (literally or figuratively)
senses: with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.27.28|Mat 27:28]] (WH, mg., R, mg.); with dupl. accusative, [[r:MAT.27.31|Mat 27:31]], [[r:MRK.15.20|Mrk 15:20]], [[r:LUK.15.22|Luk 15:22]]; mid., to put on oneself, be clothed with: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.6.25|Mat 6:25]], [[r:MRK.6.9|Mrk 6:9]], [[r:LUK.8.27|Luk 8:27 12:22]], [[r:ACT.12.21|Act 12:21]]; ptcp., [[r:MAT.22.11|Mat 22:11]], [[r:MRK.1.6|Mrk 1:6]], [[r:2CO.5.3|2Co 5:3]], [[r:REV.1.13|Rev 1:13 15:6 19:14]]; of armour (figuratively): [[r:ROM.13.12|Rom 13:12]], [[r:EPH.6.11|Eph 6:11, 14]], [[r:1TH.5.8|1Th 5:8]]; metaphorically, δύναμιν, [[r:LUK.24.49|Luk 24:49]]; ἀφθαρσίαν, ἀθανασίαν, [[r:1CO.15.53|1Co 15:53-54]]; τ. καινὸν ἄνθρωπον, [[r:EPH.4.24|Eph 4:24]], [[r:COL.3.10|Col 3:10]]; σπλάγχνα οἰκτιρμοῦ, [[r:COL.3.12|Col 3:12]]; Ἰησ. Χριστόν, [[r:ROM.13.14|Rom 13:14]], [[r:GAL.3.27|Gal 3:27]],

(ἐνθυμέομαι), consideration, pondering (EV, device): [[r:ACT.17.29|Act 17:29]]; pl., thoughts, feel­ings: [[r:MAT.9.4|Mat 9:4 12:25]], [[r:HEB.4.12|Heb 4:12]].† SYN.: ἔννοια, the action of the reason; while ἐνθ. is rather that of the affections (cf. Westc., Heb., l.with) (AS)

G1706.strongs: to fall on, i.e. (literally) to be entrapped by, or (figuratively) be overwhelmed with
senses: ἐμ-πίπτω to fall into: before εἰς, [[r:MAT.12.11|Mat 12:11]], [[r:LUK.6.39|Luk 6:39 10:36]]; metaphorically, εἰς κρίμα, [[r:1TI.3.6|1Ti 3:6]]; ὀνειδισμόν [[r:1TI.3.7|1Ti 3:7]]; πειρασμόν, [[r:1TI.6.9|1Ti 6:9]]; εἰς χεῖρας θεοῦ (cf. [[r:2KI.24.14|2Ki 24:14]], [[r:1CH.21.13|1Ch 21:13]], [[r:SIR.2.18|Sir 2:18]]), [[r:HEB.10.31|Heb 10:31]].† (AS)
a passenger on shipboard, one on a journey.

G1754.kjv: do, (be) effectual (fervent), be mighty in, shew forth self, work (effectually in)
senses: (for full lexical treatment, see AR, Eph., 243 ff.);

intrans., to be at work or in action, to operate (opposite to ἀργέω): before ἐν, with dative of person(s), [[r:MAT.14.2|Mat 14:2]], [[r:MRK.6.14|Mrk 6:14]], [[r:EPH.2.2|Eph 2:2]]; with dative of person(s), before εἰς (Lft., in l), [[r:GAL.2.8|Gal 2:8.]]

Trans., to work, effect, do: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:1CO.12.11|1Co 12:11]], [[r:EPH.1.11|Eph 1:11]]; id, before ἐν, with dative of person(s), [[r:1CO.12.6|1Co 12:6]], [[r:GAL.3.5|Gal 3:5]], [[r:PHP.2.13|Php 2:13]]; ἐ. ἐνέργειαν, [[r:EPH.1.19|Eph 1:19-20]] Pass. (taken as mid. by Lft., Ga., 204 f.; but see AR, Eph., l.with; Milligan, Th., 28 f.; Mayor, Ja., 177 ff.), in NT, "always used of some principle or power at work" (Meyer), to be actuated, set in operation: [[r:2TH.2.7|2Th 2:7]]; before ἐν, [[r:ROM.7.5|Rom 7:5]], [[r:2CO.1.6|2Co 1:6 4:12]], [[r:EPH.3.20|Eph 3:20]], [[r:COL.1.29|Col 1:29]], [[r:1TH.2.13|1Th 2:13]]; before διά, with genitive of thing(s), [[r:GAL.5.6|Gal 5:6]]; ἐνεργουμένη (M, Pr., 156), [[r:JAS.5.16|Jas 5:16]] (Cremer, 262).† (AS)

ἐν-αντίος, -α, -ον (ἀντίος, set against), over against, opposite, contrary: ἄνεμος, [[r:MAT.14.24|Mat 14:24]], [[r:MRK.6.48|Mrk 6:48]], [[r:ACT.27.4|Act 27:4]]; ἐξ ἐναντίας (ellipse obscure, see Bl., § 44,1; Mozley, [[r:PSA.42.1|Psa 42:1-11]]), with genitive, [[r:MRK.15.39|Mrk 15:39.]] Metaphorical, opposed, hostile: [[r:1TH.2.15|1Th 2:15]], [[r:ACT.26.9|Act 26:9 28:17]]; ὁ ἐξ ἐ., [[r:TIT.2.8|Tit 2:8.]] Neuter., -ίον, adv., as prep. with genitive, before, in the presence of: [[r:LUK.1.6|Luk 1:6 20:26 24:19]] [[r:ACT.7.10|Act 7:10]] (ἔναντι, T), [[r:ACT.8.32|Act 8:32]] (LXX).† (AS)

G1759.strongs: properly, within, i.e. (of place) here, hither

G1768.root: from a (tenth) multiple of [[w:G1767]] and [[w:G1767]] itself
senses: ἐννενήκοντα, see: ἐνεν-. ἐνενήκοντα (Rec. ἐννεν-), οἱ, αἱ, τά indecl., ninety: [[r:MAT.18.12|Mat 18:12-13]], [[r:LUK.15.4|Luk 15:4]], 7.† (AS)

G1788.strongs: to invert, i.e. (figuratively and reflexively) in a good sense, to respect; or in a bad one, to confound
senses: ἐν-τρέπω to turn about; metaphorically, put to shame: with accusative, [[r:1CO.4.14|1Co 4:14]]; pass., [[r:2TH.3.14|2Th 3:14]], [[r:TIT.2.8|Tit 2:8]]; mid., to reverence: with accusative of person(s) (cl. with genitive), [[r:MAT.21.37|Mat 21:37]], [[r:MRK.12.6|Mrk 12:6]], [[r:LUK.18.2|Luk 18:2, 4 20:13]], [[r:HEB.12.9|Heb 12:9]] (cf. MM, Exp., iii, xiii).† (AS)

G1714.root: from [[w:G1722]] and πρήθω (to blow a flame)
G1714.strongs: to enkindle, i.e. set on fire
senses: ἐμ-πίπρημι, ἐμπρήθω (for the form, see: ἐμπίπλημι, and cf. Veitch, see word πίμπρημι), to set on fire: πόλιν, [[r:MAT.22.7|Mat 22:7]]; pass., of the body, to become inflamed: [[r:ACT.28.6|Act 28:6]] (T; πίμπρημι WH, which see).† (AS)

(ἐν), adv., within: with genitive, ἐ. ὑμῶν, within you (i.e. in your hearts, R, txt.), or among you (R, mg.), [[r:LUK.17.21|Luk 17:21]] (cf. Field, Notes, 71; Thayer, see word; ICC, Lk, l.with; Dalman, Words, 145 ff.); τὸ ἐ., [[r:MAT.23.26|Mat 23:26.]]† (AS)

G1779.strongs: to inswathe with cerements for interment
senses: ἐνταφιάζω a κοινή word (Deiss., LAE, 723), to prepare for burial: [[r:MAT.26.12|Mat 26:12]], [[r:JHN.19.40|Jhn 19:40]].† (AS)
ἐμ-πτύω = cl., καταπτύω (Ruth., NPhr., 66), to spit upon: with dative, [[r:MRK.10.34|Mrk 10:34 14:65 15:19]]; before εἰς, [[r:MAT.26.67|Mat 26:67 27:30]]. Pass., [[r:LUK.18.32|Luk 18:32.]]† (AS)

G1718.strongs: to exhibit (in person) or disclose (by words)
G1718.kjv: appear, declare (plainly), inform, (will) manifest, shew, signify
senses: to manifest, exhibit: ἐαυτόν, with dative of person(s), [[r:JHN.14.21|Jhn 14:21-22]] (DCG, ii, 112b). Pass. and mid., to show oneself, appear: [[r:MAT.27.53|Mat 27:53]], [[r:HEB.9.24|Heb 9:24]] (cf. MM, Exp., xii).

to declare, make known: before ὅτι, [[r:HEB.11.14|Heb 11:14]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.23.15|Act 23:15]]; with accusative of thing(s), before πρός, [[r:ACT.23.22|Act 23:22]]; κατά, with genitive of person(s), [[r:ACT.24.1|Act 24:1 25:2]]; περί, [[r:ACT.25.15|Act 25:15.]]† SYN.: δηλόω, q.v (AS)

G1794.strongs: probably akin to); to entwine, i.e. wind up in
senses: ἐν-τυλίσσω to wrap up (LS), roll or coil about (DCG, ii, 227, 507a): with accusative and dative, [[r:MAT.27.59|Mat 27:59]] (iv, Tr., cf. similar sentence in π.; MM, Exp., xiii), [[r:LUK.23.53|Luk 23:53]]; pass., [[r:JHN.20.7|Jhn 20:7.]]† (AS)
ἕν-δεκα, οἱ, αἱ, τά indecl., eleven: of the eleven apostles, οἱ, ἕ., [[r:MAT.28.16|Mat 28:16]], [[r:MRK.16.14|Mrk 16:14]], [[r:LUK.24.9|Luk 24:9, 33]], [[r:ACT.1.26|Act 1:26 2:14]].† (AS)

G1773.root: neuter of a compound of [[w:G1722]] and [[w:G3571]]
senses: (νύξ), (in cl. poët.; prose in late Gk. only) nightly. Neut., adverbially, ἔννυχα (Rec. -χον), by night: [[r:MRK.1.35|Mrk 1:35.]]† (AS)

ἐν-αντίος, -α, -ον (ἀντίος, set against), over against, opposite, contrary: ἄνεμος, [[r:MAT.14.24|Mat 14:24]], [[r:MRK.6.48|Mrk 6:48]], [[r:ACT.27.4|Act 27:4]]; ἐξ ἐναντίας (ellipse obscure, see Bl., § 44,1; Mozley, [[r:PSA.42.1|Psa 42:1-11]]), with genitive, [[r:MRK.15.39|Mrk 15:39.]] Metaphorical, opposed, hostile: [[r:1TH.2.15|1Th 2:15]], [[r:ACT.26.9|Act 26:9 28:17]]; ὁ ἐξ ἐ., [[r:TIT.2.8|Tit 2:8.]] Neuter., -ίον, adv., as prep. with genitive, before, in the presence of: [[r:LUK.1.6|Luk 1:6 20:26 24:19]] [[r:ACT.7.10|Act 7:10]] (ἔναντι, T), [[r:ACT.8.32|Act 8:32]] (LXX).† (AS)

G1758.strongs: to hold in or upon, i.e. ensnare; by implication, to keep a grudge
G1758.kjv: entangle with, have a quarrel against, urge
senses: to hold in; pass., to be held, entangled: with dative of thing(s); jig., ζυγῷ δουλείας, [[r:GAL.5.1|Gal 5:1]] (cf. MM, Exp., xii); θλίψρεσιν, [[r:2TH.1.4|2Th 1:4]] (cf. ἀσεβείσιν, 3Mac, l.with).
to set oneself against, be urgent against (as Ge, l.with; for con­struction, see Swete, Mk., l.with): [[r:MRK.6.19|Mrk 6:19]], [[r:LUK.11.53|Luk 11:53]].† (AS)

G1723.strongs: to take in one's arms, i.e. embrace

senses: ἐνδιδύσκω to put on: with dupl. accusative, [[r:MRK.15.17|Mrk 15:17]] (ἐνδύουσι, Rec.). Mid., to put on oneself, be clothed in: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:LUK.16.19|Luk 16:19]] (cf. MM, Exp., xii).† (AS)
ἐν-ειλέω, -ῶ to roll in, wind in: with accusative of person(s) and dative of thing(s), [[r:MRK.15.46|Mrk 15:46.]]† (AS)
ἔν-αντι adv., a κοινή word (MM, Exp., xii), before; as prep., with genitive: [[r:LUK.1.8|Luk 1:8]], [[r:ACT.7.10|Act 7:10]] (WH, ἐναντίον), [[r:ACT.8.21|Act 8:21.]]† (AS)

G1799.root: neuter of a compound of [[w:G1722]] and a derivative of [[w:G3700]]
G1799.strongs: in the face of (literally or figuratively)
G1799.kjv: before, in the presence (sight) of, to
senses: ἐνώπιος, -ον (ὤψ), face to face, in sight (Theocr.; ἄρτοι ἐ., [[r:EXO.25.29|Exo 25:29]]): neut., ἐνώπιον, in vernacular, with force of prep. with genitive, in NT, most frequently in Lk, Ac, Re, never in Mt, Mk, before, in the presence of: [[r:LUK.1.19|Luk 1:19]] [[r:LUK.4.7|Luk 4:7]], [[r:ACT.4.10|Act 4:10]] [[r:ACT.6.5|Act 6:5]], [[r:REV.1.4|Rev 1:4 2:14]], al.; esp. ἐ. Κυρίου (θεοῦ), in the sight of God, or with God as witness or as judge, [[r:ROM.14.22|Rom 14:22]], [[r:1CO.1.29|1Co 1:29]], [[r:1TI.2.3|1Ti 2:3]], [[r:JAS.4.10|Jas 4:10]], [[r:1PE.3.4|1Pe 3:4]], al. (AS)

G1705.strongs: to fill in (up), i.e. (by implication) to satisfy (literally or figuratively)
senses: ἐμ-πίπλημι (on ἐμπίμπ-, see LS, see word, Bl., § 6, 8), and ἐμπιπλάω ([[r:ACT.14.17|Act 14:17]]), to fill full, fill up, satisfy: with accusative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), [[r:LUK.1.53|Luk 1:53]], [[r:ACT.14.17|Act 14:17]]; pass., [[r:LUK.6.25|Luk 6:25]], [[r:JHN.6.12|Jhn 6:12]]; metaphorically, with genitive of person(s), to take one's fill of: [[r:ROM.15.24|Rom 15:24]] (cf. Dan LXX Su 32).† (AS)

G1770.strongs: to nod at, i.e. beckon or communicate by gesture
senses: ἐν-νεύω to nod to, make a sign to: with dative of person(s), [[r:LUK.1.62|Luk 1:62.]]† (AS)

G1782.strongs: hence (literally or figuratively); (repeated) on both sides
senses: of place, hence: [[r:LUK.4.9|Luk 4:9 13:31]], [[r:JHN.2.16|Jhn 2:16 7:3 14:31 18:36]]; ἐ. καὶ ἐ. (for cl. ἔνθεν κ. ἔνθεν), on this side and on that, on each side, [[r:JHN.19.18|Jhn 19:18]]; similarly, ἐ. καὶ ἐκεῖθεν, [[r:REV.22.2|Rev 22:2.]]

G1763.root: prolongation from a primary ἔνος (a year)
senses: = ἔτος, a year: [[r:JHN.11.49|Jhn 11:49, 51 18:13]], [[r:ACT.11.26|Act 11:26 18:11]], [[r:JAS.5.17|Jas 5:17]], [[r:REV.9.15|Rev 9:15]]; pl., of sabbatical years, [[r:GAL.4.10|Gal 4:10]]; ποιεῖν ἐ., to spend a year, [[r:JAS.4.13|Jas 4:13]];ἅπαξ τοῦ ἐ., [[r:HEB.9.7|Heb 9:7]]; κατ᾽ ἐ., [[r:HEB.9.25|Heb 9:25 10:1, 3]]; ἐ. δεκτόν, [[r:LUK.4.19|Luk 4:19]] (LXX).† (AS)

G1776.strongs: to crowd in, i.e. (figuratively) to annoy
senses: ἐν-οχλέω, -ῶ (ὄχλος), to trouble: with accusative, [[r:HEB.12.15|Heb 12:15.]] Pass., before ἀπό, [[r:LUK.6.18|Luk 6:18.]]† (AS)

G1784.kjv: dear, more honourable, precious, in reputation
senses: (τιμή), honoured, prized, precious: of persons, [[r:LUK.7.2|Luk 7:2]], [[r:PHP.2.29|Php 2:29]]; compar., [[r:LUK.14.8|Luk 14:8]]; of things, metaphorically, λίθος, [[r:1PE.2.4|1Pe 2:4 2:6]]" (LXX).† (AS)
glorious, splendid: of deeds, τά ἔ., [[r:LUK.13.17|Luk 13:17]]; of clothing, [[r:LUK.7.25|Luk 7:25.]] Metaphorical, ἐκκλησία, [[r:EPH.5.27|Eph 5:27]] (cf. παράδοξος).† (AS)
to be in, within ([[r:JOB.27.3|Job 27:3]], al.): ptcp. pl., τὰ ἐνόντα, [[r:LUK.11.41|Luk 11:41]] (R, txt., cf. MM, Exp., xii).
(ἐνέδρα), to lie in wait for: with accusative of person(s), [[r:LUK.11.54|Luk 11:54]], [[r:ACT.23.21|Act 23:21]].† (AS)

G1735.root: third person singular present of a compound of [[w:G1722]] and [[w:G1209]]
G1735.strongs: (impersonally) it is accepted in, i.e. admitted (possible)
senses: to be possible; impers., ἑνδέχεται, it is possible: with accusative and inf., [[r:LUK.13.33|Luk 13:33]] (Cremer, 687).† (AS)
ἐν-ισχύω to strengthen: in spiritual sense, [[r:LUK.22.43|Luk 22:43]]; pass., [[r:ACT.9.19|Act 9:19]] (Rec. ἐνισχύσεν, became strong, as in LXX, [[r:GEN.12.10|Gen 12:10 48:2]], al.).† (AS)
ἐμ-φυσάω, -ῶ (φυσάω, to blow), to breathe into (cf. [[r:GEN.2.7|Gen 2:7]], [[r:WIS.15.11|Wis 15:11]], a1.), breathe upon: [[r:JHN.20.22|Jhn 20:22.]]† (AS)

G1798.strongs: something seen in sleep, i.e. a dream (vision in a dream)

senses: (ἐνύπνιον), to dream: ἐνυπνίοις ἐ., [[r:ACT.2.17|Act 2:17]] (LXX); present ptcp., Ju 8.† (AS)

G1729.root: from a compound of [[w:G1722]] and [[w:G1210]] (in the sense of lacking)

G1709.strongs: to inhale, i.e. (figuratively) to be animated by (bent upon)
senses: with genitive part.: figuratively, ἀπειλῆς κ. φόνου, [[r:ACT.9.1|Act 9:1.]]† (AS)

G1769.strongs: dumb (as making signs), i.e. silent from astonishment

senses: ἐν-δυναμόω, -ῶ to make strong, strengthen: with accusative, of person(s), [[r:PHP.4.13|Php 4:13]], [[r:1TI.1.12|1Ti 1:12]], [[r:2TI.4.17|2Ti 4:17]]. Pass., [[r:ACT.9.22|Act 9:22]]; C. dative, [[r:ROM.4.20|Rom 4:20]]; before ἐν, [[r:2TI.2.1|2Ti 2:1]] (ἐν Κυρίῳ), [[r:EPH.6.10|Eph 6:10]] (Cremer, 221).† (AS)
(ἐμφαίνω, to show in, exhibit), manifest: [[r:ACT.10.40|Act 10:40]]; metaphorically, [[r:ROM.10.20|Rom 10:20]] (LXX) (see: ἐπιφανής).† (AS)
under law: ἔ. Χριστοῦ, in relation to Christ, [[r:1CO.9.21|1Co 9:21]] (Cremer. 435).† (AS)

G1747.root: feminine from [[w:G1722]] and the base of [[w:G1476]]
senses: ἐν-έδρα, -ας, ἡ (ἕδρα, a seat), a lying in wait, an ambush: [[r:ACT.23.16|Act 23:16]] (Rec. ἔνεδρον, a form frequently in LXX), [[r:ACT.25.8|Act 25:8.]]† (AS)

G1793.strongs: to chance upon, i.e. (by implication) confer with; by extension to entreat (in favor or against)
senses: to meet with in order to converse.

to petition, make petition: with dative of person(s), before ὑπέρ with genitive of person(s), [[r:ACT.25.24|Act 25:24]] (cf. Field, Notes, 140), [[r:HEB.7.25|Heb 7:25]], [[r:ROM.8.27|Rom 8:27, 34]] (θεῷ, not expressed); before κατά, against: [[r:ROM.11.2|Rom 11:2]] (cf. ἔντευξις, ὑπερ-εντυγχάνω).† (AS)

to show forth, prove: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:ROM.2.15|Rom 2:15 9:22]], [[r:EPH.2.7|Eph 2:7]], [[r:TIT.2.10|Tit 2:10 3:2]], [[r:HEB.6.11|Heb 6:11]]; before ἐν, with dative of person(s), [[r:ROM.9.17|Rom 9:17]] (LXX), [[r:1TI.1.16|1Ti 1:16]]; before εἰς, [[r:HEB.6.10|Heb 6:10]] (with cogn. accusative), [[r:2CO.8.24|2Co 8:24.]]
to manifest (by act): with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), [[r:2TI.4.14|2Ti 4:14]] (cf. [[r:GEN.50.15|Gen 50:15, 17]], and see MM, Exp., xiii).† (AS)
ἔν-δειξις, -εως, ἡ (ἐνδείκνυμι), a pointing out, showing forth, proof (see: ἔνδειγμα): [[r:ROM.3.25|Rom 3:25-26]], [[r:2CO.8.24|2Co 8:24]], [[r:PHP.1.28|Php 1:28]].† (AS)

ἐν-οικέω, -ῶ to dwell in; metaphorically, before ἐν, with dative of person(s): ὁ θεός, [[r:2CO.6.16|2Co 6:16]]; τ. πνεῦμα, [[r:ROM.8.11|Rom 8:11]], [[r:2TI.1.14|2Ti 1:14]]; ὁ λόγος, [[r:COL.3.16|Col 3:16]]; πίστις, [[r:2TI.1.5|2Ti 1:5]]; ἁμαρτία, [[r:ROM.7.17|Rom 7:17.]]† (AS)

G1764.strongs: to place on hand, i.e. (reflexively) impend, (participle) be instant
senses: ἐν-ίστημι to place in; in pf., plpf., 2 aor. and in mid., intrans.;

to be present: [[r:2TH.2.2|2Th 2:2]] (but see Thayer, see word); pf. ptcp., present: [[r:1CO.7.26|1Co 7:26]], [[r:GAL.1.4|Gal 1:4]], [[r:HEB.9.9|Heb 9:9]]; pl., [[r:ROM.8.38|Rom 8:38]], [[r:1CO.3.22|1Co 3:22]] (Cremer, 3O9).† (AS)
with genitive of person(s), respect, reverence (Soph., Polyb., al.).

G1762.root: contraction for the third person singular present indicative of [[w:G1751]]
G1762.strongs: impersonally, there is in or among
senses: ἔνι Ionic form of ἐν (ἐνί), with strengthened accent; = ἔνεστι, is in, has place, can be: [[r:1CO.6.5|1Co 6:5]], [[r:GAL.3.28|Gal 3:28]] (tris) [[r:COL.3.11|Col 3:11]], [[r:JAS.1.17|Jas 1:17]] (cf. Lft., Ga.; Hort and Mayor, Ja., ll. with).† (AS)
ἐνεργής, -ές (late form of ἐνεργός, on WH. cf. AR, Eph., 241), at work, active, effective: [[r:1CO.16.9|1Co 16:9]], Phm 6, [[r:HEB.4.12|Heb 4:12]] (Cremer, 261).† (AS)
ἐν-τυπόω, -ῶ (τύπος), to imprint, engrave: pass. ptcp., with dative, [[r:2CO.3.7|2Co 3:7.]]† (AS)

G1736.strongs: to be in one's own country, i.e. home (figuratively)
senses: (ἔνδημος, living in a place), to live in a place, be at home: ἐν τ. σώματι, [[r:2CO.5.6|2Co 5:6 5:9]]; πρὸς τ. Kύριον, [[r:2CO.5.8|2Co 5:8.]]† (AS)

G1704.strongs: to perambulate on a place, i.e. (figuratively) to be occupied among persons
senses: ἐν-περι-πατέω, -ῶ (Rec. ἐμπ-, see: ἐν) to walk about in or among: before ἐν., dative of person(s), [[r:2CO.6.16|2Co 6:16]] (LXX),† (AS)

(ἐνεργής), operative power (as distinct from δύναμις, potential power), working: of God, [[r:EPH.1.19|Eph 1:19 3:7 4:16]], [[r:PHP.3.21|Php 3:21]], [[r:COL.1.29|Col 1:29 2:12]]; of Satan, [[r:2TH.2.9|2Th 2:9 2:11]] (cf. M, Th., l.with; AR, Eph., 241 ff.; Cremer, 261).† (AS)

ἔν-δειγμα, -τος (ἐνδείκνυμι), a plain token, proof: [[r:2TH.1.5|2Th 1:5]] (cf. ἔνδειξις, which refers rather to the "act of proving"; ἔ., with the passive formation, to the thing proved, see Lft., Notes, 100; M, Th., l.with).† SYN.: τεκμήριον (AS)
a petition (in this sense common in π.; cf. Deiss., BS, 121 f., 146; MM, Exp., iii): [[r:1TI.4.5|1Ti 4:5]]; p1., [[r:1TI.2.1|1Ti 2:1.]]† SYN.: δέησις (which see) (AS)
ἐν-τρέφω to train up, nurture; pass., metaphorically, τοῖς λόγοις τ. πίστεως, [[r:1TI.4.6|1Ti 4:6.]]† (AS)
ἐμ-πλέκω to weave in, entwine; pass., metaphorically, to be involved, entangled in: [[r:2TI.2.4|2Ti 2:4]], [[r:2PE.2.20|2Pe 2:20]].† (AS)

G1744.strongs: to sink (by implication, wrap (compare) on, i.e. (figuratively) sneak
senses: with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.27.28|Mat 27:28]] (WH, mg., R, mg.); with dupl. accusative, [[r:MAT.27.31|Mat 27:31]], [[r:MRK.15.20|Mrk 15:20]], [[r:LUK.15.22|Luk 15:22]]; mid., to put on oneself, be clothed with: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.6.25|Mat 6:25]], [[r:MRK.6.9|Mrk 6:9]], [[r:LUK.8.27|Luk 8:27 12:22]], [[r:ACT.12.21|Act 12:21]]; ptcp., [[r:MAT.22.11|Mat 22:11]], [[r:MRK.1.6|Mrk 1:6]], [[r:2CO.5.3|2Co 5:3]], [[r:REV.1.13|Rev 1:13 15:6 19:14]]; of armour (figuratively): [[r:ROM.13.12|Rom 13:12]], [[r:EPH.6.11|Eph 6:11, 14]], [[r:1TH.5.8|1Th 5:8]]; metaphorically, δύναμιν, [[r:LUK.24.49|Luk 24:49]]; ἀφθαρσίαν, ἀθανασίαν, [[r:1CO.15.53|1Co 15:53-54]]; τ. καινὸν ἄνθρωπον, [[r:EPH.4.24|Eph 4:24]], [[r:COL.3.10|Col 3:10]]; σπλάγχνα οἰκτιρμοῦ, [[r:COL.3.12|Col 3:12]]; Ἰησ. Χριστόν, [[r:ROM.13.14|Rom 13:14]], [[r:GAL.3.27|Gal 3:27]],
a thought, purpose, design: [[r:HEB.4.12|Heb 4:12]], [[r:1PE.4.1|1Pe 4:1]].† SYN.: ἐνθῦμησις, which see (Cremer, 439) (AS)
ἐν-άλιος, -ον (also -α, -ον; ἅλς, the sea), of the sea: τὰ ἐ., marine creatures, [[r:JAS.3.7|Jas 3:7.]]† (AS)

G1710.strongs: to travel in (a country as a pedlar), i.e. (by implication) to trade
senses: C. accusative of person(s), to make a gain of: [[r:2PE.2.3|2Pe 2:3.]]† (AS)
ἐν-τρυφάω, ῶ to revel in: ἐν-τ. ἀπάταις, [[r:2PE.2.13|2Pe 2:13]] (see Mayor, in l).† (AS)

G1703.strongs: a derider, i.e. (by implication) a false teacher

G1739.root: from a compound of [[w:G1722]] and a derivative of the base of [[w:G1218]]
senses: ἐν-δώμησις (Rec. -δόμησις), -εως, ἡ (δωμάω, to build), a build­ing in: ἡ ἐ. τ. τείχους αὐτῆς ἴασπις, its wall had jasper built into it, [[r:REV.21.18|Rev 21:18]] (see MM, Exp., xiii; Swete, Ap., l.with).† (AS)
